result.stdout:
glider-trace 0.3.0
Runtime evidence MCP server for C#/.NET agents (stdio or HTTP).
Requires .NET 10 SDK.

Usage:
  glider-trace [--transport stdio|http] [--port <n>] [--workspace <path>] [--artifact-root <path>] [--default-timeout <duration>] [--verbose]
  glider-trace --version
  glider-trace --help

Options:
  --transport <stdio|http>   Transport to use (default: stdio).
  --port <n>                 HTTP port (default: 5001).
  --workspace <path>         Workspace root for trace operations (default: current directory).
  --artifact-root <path>     Artifact root (default: <workspace>/.glider-trace).
  --default-timeout <value>  Default timeout for async tools (default: 20m). Use 0 to disable.
                             Supported units: ms, s, m (for example: 10ms, 10s, 10m).
  --verbose                  Enable logging.
  --version, -v              Print version and exit.
  --help, -h                 Show this help and exit.
